mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST YoY < -10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a shift towards service-oriented growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous quarter AND INDPRO < previous month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 increases and INDPRO decreases.
